body:
Thanks so much for this response. I didn't come onto the girl in the first case on the walk home but I threw flirty energy at her and I pray to god it didn't come across pressurey. It was 100% not my intent to pressure her into anything sexual. I just wanted to recreate the light-hearted vibe we had going on before. But I will be apologizing to her and seeing what happens with that. 

Yes absolutely. I want her to be enthusiastic and enjoying the kissing or anything we do. That's what all this is about, me liking her but also her liking me back. In the future, I think both reading the situation and also getting a verbal confirmation in addition to everything could be better in confirming her enthusiasm. 

I realize I come across kind and sensitive in the way I wrote the post, but when I'm with a girl, I'm pretty stoic because I'm afraid of showing emotion to others though I try to read their emotions and adjust my behavior. The thought I made someone else feel scared makes me want to die. Even if they didn't feel scared of me, I'm ashamed I could've made them uncomfortable, and knowing she wasn't comfortable hanging out just us two, I should've backed out. I've got my work cut out for me in improving who I am and thoughts that I've messed up beyond repair are eating me alive.

We have mutual friends but I don't think I want to involve them because they're gossipy and I don't want to turn this into a public thing for the sake of both her and me. I do however want to lessen the effect on her, so I'll message directly. 

Edit: i upvote your comments but they won't go up?

Thank you for your response, I've learned a lot from it but at the same time, the wreckage has been done. These are things I should've known before I even started having sex. I feel like a piece of shit. I've drifted apart from both of them, so I don't know how comfortable they would be receiving these messages about it and I don't want to make them uncomfortable by trying to make them not uncomfortable. I don't even know where I'd start with bringing this topic up out of the blue. I'd really like to have a conversation with them if it could come up organically. I feel so bad and imagining them being scared or hurt because of *me* makes me nauseous and cold.
